items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: I don't think they were working steadily together because Johnny was with an orchestra that played out at the stadium for a long time.

ctx.x: Oh yes. He played the clarinet. See.
Was Jimmy working with Johnny or just happened to pick him up to?
I don't think they were working steadily together because Johnny was with an orchestra that played out at the stadium for a long time.
